## COMPETITOR RANKING TABLE

*Ranked by Engagement Rate (ER = Avg Interactions / Followers)*

| Handle | Followers | Avg Likes | Eng Rate | Top Content Type |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **@garvit.irl** *(Benchmark)* | **5,961** | **320** | **36.24%** | Highly interactive community discussions & comment-driven prompts |
| **@dhavalkataria_** | 50,340 | 9,129.9 | 18.14% | Keyword DM triggers ("CFO", "PROOF") tied to tangible resources |
| **@favourite.engineer** | 154,215 | 11,898.2 | 7.72% | "Power of [X]" visual agent & prompt demonstrations |
| **@aryamanupmanyu** | 74,208 | 2,008.2 | 2.71% | Case-study builds with "Comment AI" DM funnels |
| **@thevarunmayya** | 1,274,663 | 14,141.3 | 1.11% | High-authority industry interviews & deep tech commentary |
| **@vaibhavsisinty** | 2,123,924 | 18,044.9 | 0.85% | Curated AI news roundups & feature release breakdowns |
| **@nick_saraev** | 661,454 | 3,800.5 | 0.57% | Free resource giveaways (Libraries, Courses, Clone tools) |
| **@arshman** | 375,281 | 1,975.0 | 0.53% | Counter-intuitive hooks & Claude deep-dive tutorials |
| **@ishansharma7390** | 1,271,895 | 3,724.7 | 0.29% | Personal narrative mixed with prompt bundle giveaways |
| **@nivedan.ai** | 525,210 | 732.8 | 0.14% | Milestone updates & founder storytelling |

---

## GROWTH GAPS

1. **Lack of High-Impact Visual Hooks ("Power of [X]" Format)**  
   *Competitor Benchmark: `@favourite.engineer` (up to 69.9k likes per post)*  
   Competitors driving the highest raw like volume focus on rapid, visually satisfying demonstrations of working AI agents/prompts rather than abstract advice. @garvit.irl has exceptional comment engagement but lags in top-of-funnel visual hooks that drive passive viewers to like and share.

2. **Under-Monetized Comment Velocity into DM Automation**  
   *Competitor Benchmark: `@dhavalkataria_` (32.8k likes), `@nick_saraev`*  
   @garvit.irl commands a 1,840.5 median comment volume. However, top accounts use single-word automated trigger funnels (e.g., *Comment "CFO" or "DESIGN"*) to convert comment volume into DM leads, automated shares, and algorithmic distribution boosts.

3. **Absence of Negative / FOMO-Driven Educational Hooks**  
   *Competitor Benchmark: `@arshman` (11.7k likes on "Features 99% don't know exist")*  
   High-performing technical breakdown reels leverage negative positioning (e.g., *"Two Claude problems nobody talks about"*, *"Stop using ChatGPT like the bottom 99%"*). Framing AI tips as insider fixes drives significantly higher save rates and reach outside the existing follower base.

---

## RECOMMENDED ACTIONS

1. **Launch a "Power of [AI Agent]" Reel Template**  
   Produce 2 reels this week following the high-velocity hook format: show the final result in the first 2 seconds, demonstrate the 3-step build in under 30 seconds, and end on the direct output.
2. **Deploy a Keyword DM Funnel on High-Value Assets**  
   Capitalize on your 1,840+ median comment rate by packaging a prompt pack or tool list and requiring a specific 1-word comment trigger (e.g., `Comment "PROMPT"`) to receive the link via ManyChat/automated DM.
3. **Execute a "99% Are Doing This Wrong" Claude/AI Breakdown**  
   Create a single high-retention breakdown reel addressing common workflow limitations (usage limits, context rot, prompt flaws) to target external discoverability and new follower acquisition.
